rules.description: SYN connection attempt to the auction service.
Complete SELL command lines in the request direction after TCP reassembly and retransmission removal.
Complete BID command lines in the request direction after TCP reassembly and retransmission removal.
Complete OUTBID/TOP_BID command lines in the response direction after TCP reassembly and retransmission removal.
Complete CLOSED/WINNER command lines in the response direction after TCP reassembly and retransmission removal.

manual_checks: The supplied command counter uses LF/CRLF framing. If E1 selects JSON or binary framing, supply and test the corresponding decoder in the student validator; do not replace logical counts with frame counts.
Correlate client identities, topics/keys and request IDs with pytest assertions to prove the required application behaviour.
R1 R2 R3 R4: Decode the command framing and assert bidder identity, monotonic top bid and outbid notification.
R5: Assert the correct winner and closing time; reject bids after closure.
